purpose: Audit varied public Tate pages, including an anonymous route to accessible visitor information, and examine website-specific sustainability claims; exclude purchasing, accounts and form submissions.

pages.task: Find Tate Modern visitor information from the public homepage.
Find opening times, free admission and accessible-parking information without making a booking.
pages.sampleRationale: Visitor-information template with maps, tabs and long-form practical details.

pages.task: Browse the public exhibition and event listing without selecting a purchase.
Read the exhibition description, dates and visitor details without entering ticket purchase.
pages.sampleRationale: Image-rich exhibition detail template, discovered from current homepage links.

pages.task: Browse editorial stories and identify video, audio and reading choices without media playback.
Read the website-specific sustainability commitment and reported actions.
pages.sampleRationale: Distinct lightweight policy template and service-specific impact claims; HTTP200 text retrieved, one exploratory browser navigation timed out.

pages.task: Read the public cookie policy and identify available controls.
pages.sampleRationale: Privacy/consent policy template; sampled because homepage offered no visible cookie banner.

journeys.task: Follow the Tate Modern gallery card from the homepage, open the Accessibility section and read the accessible-parking location and advance-booking contact information; stop before booking or contacting anyone.

success.text: There are twelve parking spaces for disabled visitors, accessed via Park Street.

contextScopes.access-barriers: Anonymous English readers using desktop Chromium with pointer input and JavaScript, 1440 by 1000 CSS pixels: start at https://www.tate.org.uk/, follow the Tate Modern gallery card, open Accessibility, and read the accessible-parking location plus advance-booking phone/email instructions. Completion is obtaining public information; no parking booking, ticket purchase, account, contact or form submission. Keyboard-only, assistive-technology, constrained-device and physical-gallery accessibility are outside this assessment scope.
contextScopes.sustainability-goals: The tate.org.uk web service and Tate Digital Green Team commitments described in Creating a greener website: assess the stated 2019 estimated 45 tonnes CO2e baseline, reported 2023 estimated 27 tonnes CO2e result, metric/boundary comparability and ongoing reduction direction as published on 2026-11-06. Exclude Tate buildings, collection transport, commercial shop origin and total organizational emissions; published estimates are self-report, not verified measurement.
contextScopes.governance-practice: Tate Digital Green Team governance for reducing the tate.org.uk website footprint over the reported 2019–2023 baseline/progress period, plus continuing actions described on the public Digital and Creating a greener website pages captured 2026-11-06. Assess accountable review, monitored result and consequent action or reasoned continuation for that web-service commitment. No organization-wide governance or unpublished meeting evidence is in scope.

assumptions: Desktop first-load headline; narrow viewport and preferences are supplementary
No form submission or account change unless explicitly scoped

No cookie banner or accept/reject button appeared during the fresh anonymous homepage visit and verified visitor journey; branches preserve the observed initial state, without claiming absence of tracking or a site-wide consent guarantee.
Cookie policy HTTP text mentions consent and OneTrust placeholders; those are not verified working accept/reject controls.
Public information only: no shop origin, ticket purchase, account, newsletter submission, booking, email or telephone contact.
Exploratory browser timeout for the greener-website page is an access/measurement limitation, not a site failure; do not repeatedly probe blocked routes.
